paras.en: The standard deviation is the most commonly used measure of dispersion. It fulfills all the requisites of a good measure of dispersion except that it is sensitive to extreme values. It is abbreviated as S.D. A small value of the S.D for a data set indicates less spread while a larger value of the S.D indicates more spread around the mean. It is denoted by σ (lower case sigma of the Greek alphabets) in population case and s in sample case. The positive square root of the average of the squared deviations of observations taken from mean is called standard deviation. Mathematically;
